title: Storm Charles archive
what: The data files behind storm-charles.promptugal.news (Lisbon and Madeira, 10 to 12 November 2026): decisions, exposure, flights, transport, weather and the signal timeline, every file with its size and sha256, checked against the bytes served.

schedule.how: archived once on 17 November 2026 (node sources/storm-charles-archive/collect.mjs); the storm is over and its site keeps its own addresses (its api/v1 contract)

terms.summary: The storm site's own data: Apache-2.0 (its repository's licence). Quoted sources keep their own terms; each item links its source.
terms.republish: yes for the site's own data; each quoted source on its own terms

vault.name: promptugal-data-storm-charles-archive
vault.layout: index.json (the catalogue as read) and <incident>/<path> for every file in manifest.json
vault.note: Public read key: the source is public, so anyone may read the vault. A read key is derived one way and cannot write. The write key is never in this repository.

code: the collector reads the source and writes latest.json, reads.json and the vault copy
GitHub Actions runs it every hour and deploys the site
the build makes the API, the OpenAPI description and the pages
agents: data@PrompTugal.dinis (Opus) wrote the collector, this card and the pages on 17 November 2026; data.dev@ and data.design@ (Sonnet) wrote parts of the site build and the design variations
the incident agents (incident.*@web-summit.dinis) made the archived files from 10 to 12 November 2026; see the storm site's own provenance
people: Dinis Cruz instructs; no person has checked the values yet (not reviewed)

cost.runner: one run in an agent session on 17 November 2026 (142 requests); nothing recurring
cost.build_tokens: not measured: accountant@'s ledger is not running on this account; to be added when it is
cost.note: Code only: no model is called when the data is collected.
